card.name: Purpose-limiting phrases like "for educational purposes"
card.fires_on: The word "purposes" (or a nearby comma, hyphen or "for") in usage-limit statements such as "for educational purposes only" or "personal, non-commercial use". It follows words like educational, informational or personal.

modes.label: Purposes after a type
modes.description: The word "purposes" right after educational, informational or similar in a disclaimer.
modes.example: This information sheet is for education<< purposes>> only.

modes.description: The comma or hyphen part of "personal, non-commercial use" in permission statements.
modes.example: may be used only for your personal<<,>> non-commercial use.
